question: According to the 2011 Census, the literacy rate among females in India is _________ compared to males.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lower**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census 2011, the literacy rate among females in India was **65.46%**, compared to **82.14%** for males.
 
• The gap in literacy rates between males and females highlights **gender disparity** in education.
 
• States like Kerala have a **higher female literacy rate**, while states like Bihar and Rajasthan lag behind.
 
• Government initiatives such as **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** and **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan** aim to bridge this literacy gap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• Defined as the percentage of the population aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Measured during the decennial Census in India.
 
 
 
• **Gender Disparity in Literacy:**
 
 
• Factors such as traditional societal norms, early marriage, and lack of access to education contribute to the lower literacy rate among females.
 
• Efforts are being made to ensure equal educational opportunities for all genders.
 
 
 
• **Government Schemes to Improve Female Literacy:**
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** Focuses on promoting education among girls and preventing gender-biased sex-selective elimination.
 
• **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan:** Aims to provide holistic education, including quality education for girls.
 
 
 
• **Global Comparison:**
 
 
• India's female literacy rate is lower compared to global averages, which emphasize the need for sustained efforts.
